description: This file defines the PduPart class, representing a part of a multimedia message (MMS) PDU, including headers, data, and related methods for handling message parts.

classes.name: PduPart
classes.description: Represents a part of a multimedia message, including headers, data, and methods to manipulate message part properties.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the part data as a byte array.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns a copy of the part data as a byte array.

methods.name: getDataLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the part data.

methods.name: setDataUri
methods.description: Sets the data URI for the message part.

methods.name: getDataUri
methods.description: Retrieves the data URI of the message part.

methods.name: setContentId
methods.description: Sets the Content-ID header value, adding angle brackets if necessary.

methods.name: getContentId
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-ID header value.

methods.name: setCharset
methods.description: Sets the character set parameter.

methods.name: getCharset
methods.description: Retrieves the character set parameter.

methods.name: setContentLocation
methods.description: Sets the Content-Location header value.

methods.name: getContentLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-Location header value.

methods.name: setContentDisposition
methods.description: Sets the Content-Disposition header value.

methods.name: getContentDisposition
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-Disposition header value.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the Content-Type header value.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-Type header value.

methods.name: setContentTransferEncoding
methods.description: Sets the Content-Transfer-Encoding header value.

methods.name: getContentTransferEncoding
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-Transfer-Encoding header value.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name parameter for Content-Type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name parameter for Content-Type.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename parameter for Content-Disposition.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Retrieves the filename parameter for Content-Disposition.

methods.name: generateLocation
methods.description: Generates a location string based on content location, filename, or content ID.
